blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Embattled Alas Pilipinas men’s team bowed out of medal contention in the Asian Games 2026 volleyball after absorbing its second Pool D loss to China, 21-25, 20-25, 22-25, on Monday at Park Arena Komaki. Amid the team’s challenges off the court, Bryan Bagunas led another gallant stand by the Filipino Spikers with 15 points on 12 attacks and two aces. Alas Pilipinas got eliminated from the quarterfinals race with a 0-2 preliminaries record in Aichi-Nagoya, where Bagunas revealed that the team has been dealing with struggles […]...
